meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 它会对比 HEAD 与最新已发布的 npm 版本，按 omo pure components、omo opencode、omo codex 三个发布层列出未发布的改动，读 diff 讲清真实变化，并给出每层及整体的版本号建议与分层影响矩阵。
howto.when: 当你提到“unpublished changes”“changelog”等关键词，或想弄清本地还没发布的改动时触发；它会直接开始分析，不提问、不寒暄。

say.text: 对比 HEAD 和已发布版本，列出还没发布的变更
say.note: 按三个发布层分类输出

say.text: 这次改了什么？给每层一个版本号建议
say.note: 输出分层影响矩阵与版本建议

say.text: 把未发布的改动整理成 changelog 条目
say.note: 基于 diff 描述真实改动

howto.what_en: It compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, lists unpublished changes by release layer (omo pure components, omo opencode, omo codex), describes each commit's real diff, and recommends version bumps per layer.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "unpublished changes" or "changelog" when you want to know what is not yet published. It starts the analysis immediately, with no questions.

say_en.text: Compare HEAD with published versions and list unpublished changes
What changed? Recommend a version bump per layer
Turn the unpublished changes into changelog entries
